$sources: The species: Helenium autumnale L., common sneezeweed: a perennial 0.5-1.5 m, the leaves lanceolate 4-15 cm, decurrent; heads 2.5-5 cm, the rays yellow to copper, wedge-shaped, three-lobed, swept back; the disc a globose dome; flowering August to October (Flora of North America, vol. 21, Asteraceae, Oxford University Press 2006).
The plants at the Hall of Light's plotted points (the as-built meadow, HallOfLightPlanting.swift and nature.py:922-930), heights 0.4-0.9.
name: Helenium autumnale
note: Copper, as the sheet colours it (0xC07A38 family); it flowers from August, so in June it is its leaves alone. The museum shows it in early summer, Mangzhong to Xiazhi (June).
